name: Kweisi Mfume
stance: Demands transparency and a pause on an untested AI system deployed in air-traffic control.

statements.text: Co-led the letter urging the FAA to pause its AI air-traffic tool until it proves the technology is safe.
Until they provide answers that ensure that this technology is safe, the FAA must pause its use,
